criteria.requirement: Repair contrib.concurrent.ensure_lock with finally restoration covering lock creation/subtype selection, normal exit and body/worker exceptions. Preserve exact original lock identity and whether _lock was owned, inherited, absent or explicitly None; a temporary class lock must not leak after failure. Nested contexts restore each prior level and thread_map/process_map continue using the same actual context manager. Keep normal worker error propagation, do not acquire unrelated locks or claim transaction/concurrent class-mutation isolation. Acceptance uses local locks and a one-thread failing worker, never external services.
调查真实源码、说明调用路径并澄清业务，获得方案确认后实施；交付真实工程改动、原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；独立失败返工，不以问答或文档单独计数。

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
